name: Alzar's Lechon Haus
shortDescription: Wood-fired whole lechon and lechon belly, roasted fresh for your date.

ordering.leadTimeLong: Please order at least 2–3 days ahead — we roast fresh, so we need time to prepare.

delivery.short: Free delivery within Allen, Northern Samar
delivery.outsideNote: We deliver within Allen. For anywhere outside Allen, message us and we'll see what we can do.

payment.confirmFirst: Please wait for us to confirm your order and date in Messenger before sending any payment.

depositPolicy.text: We ask for a 50% downpayment to reserve your date, with the balance due on delivery by GCash or cash.

payment.feesNote: Transfer fees may apply depending on your bank or e-wallet.
payment.scanNote: The QR is shown at the size it was supplied, so scanning it straight off this screen may not work. Tap the code to open it full size, save it to your phone, then in GCash choose Scan QR and pick it from your gallery.
